page_results.notes: Architectural floor plan A01 shows a 16.00 m x 12.00 m rectangular envelope with measurement convention: floor areas to wall centrelines and no wall-strip deductions. Room areas are printed for all spaces except G05 Hall; its area (24.00 m2) is derived directly from printed dimensions 2.00 m (central band) x 12.00 m building depth. Door and window set COUNTS are based on visible tags GD01–GD11 and GW01–GW06. Door and window SIZES are not shown on this page; opening areas are set to 0. Internal wall lengths/areas cannot be completed from this single plan because many partition extents and opening widths are not fully dimensioned; only external perimeter is dimensioned. Geometry coverage is partial: some spaces (Laundry, WC/Shower, Stairs, Foyer) lack independent dimensions for their internal splits; polygons are provided only where spans are explicitly dimensioned. This is a preliminary AI takeoff and must be reviewed by a quantity surveyor.

document_measurement_review.notes:
structure: All dimensions and counts are taken from original sheets: S01 p3 (structural sizes, counts and slab/beam extents), A04 p6 (formwork rules). Beam volume uses only the 0.25 m downstand depth; beam soffits are included within slab_formwork_area, and beam formwork counts only two vertical sides. Slab formwork is provided for suspended slabs only (first and roof). Reinforcement mass strictly follows S02 p8 schedule with dia^2/162 formula; no extras or wastage added.
surfaces: Only explicit SOURCE quantities were taken. Wall lengths/areas and ceiling areas are not derivable from the provided pages without inferred dimensions, so they are excluded.
inventory: All quantities sourced from the stated schedules and plans (pages 1–7). Dimensions in metres; counts by listed IDs. No assumptions on MEP routing or materials.

page_results.notes: Architectural floor plan A02 shows FIRST FLOOR with clear 16.00 x 12.00 centreline envelope and a 7.00 | 2.00 | 7.00 grid across and 4.00 + 4.00 + 4.00 vertically. Room areas are printed for all spaces except the Hall; Hall computed from the dimensioned 2.00 m x 12.00 m band. Floor areas follow the stated convention: measured to wall centrelines and do not deduct wall strips. Stair VOID (12 m2) excluded from floor and ceiling; open Terrace (12 m2) included in floor_area, excluded from ceiling_area. Window and door sizes are not given on this page (sizes on A03), so window_area and door_area are set to 0. Wall_length includes the full external perimeter (56 m) plus only the dimensioned grid partitions: two 12.00 m hall flanking walls and two 16.00 m horizontal walls (total internal 56 m). Undimensioned sub-partitions on the right block are not included. Wall_area is single-face area = wall_length x 3.20 m clear height. Counts taken from visible tags (FW01–FW09, FD01–FD08). This is a preliminary AI takeoff and must be reviewed by a quantity surveyor.
